notes.notes: Friends, we are pleased to announce that an update will be released soon! We added the tutorial (let's go, baby!), leveling up the elements of hero cards and the first character of the Underworld faction - Rat! Also a number of bugs have been fixed and significant (no) improvements have been made. That's all for now, but we'll be back!

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35190984/6219cc93b4f2d66348ac50da05f2d8fc75bd31e1.jpg
Friends, we hasten to inform you that next week we will release an update! We will add hero talents, the first character from the Sisters of War faction - Valkyrie, new quests, etc. We've also fixed some of the most commonly reported bugs by players - thanks for your messages and comments! That's all for now, but we'll be back!
